$comment: Single source of truth for every book-specific string + the portability seam. The engine reads only from here, so it can be shared verbatim across books as a git submodule. kit.dir is the engine path relative to this file's directory: "" means the engine lives in this same repo (single-repo mode); "kit" means it is mounted at kit/ (submodule mode — here, a symlink back to the repo root so the example builds in place).
